lines.t: Your voice... Lord, You stir my soul, You light my soul on fire, a love which this world has not known.
Why, O Lord, do You bless me so?! I have sinned greatly in my life; I have broken your commandments, and desecrated Your name and this temple You gave me, yet
Why, O Lord, do You bless me so?!
What have I done to deserve such mercy, such unfathomable joy, such overwhelming love in Your presence? You are my Lord and my God, my life!
Why, O Lord, do You bless me so?!
You are my Lord and my God, my life!
